_about: The new-world picker's catalog: what each choice is called and says. Sizes map to a config file (relative to the repository root) and its [width, height, depth]; `terrain` and `climate` name the preset that config already uses, so picking it sends nothing over the file's own tables. Terrain and climate entries are shown only when the session's `presets` query lists that name. Descriptions come from the presets' own doc comments.

sizes.description: 256 × 128 × 48 at 0.125 m: 32 m around, 16 m tall, 6 m deep.

sizes.description: 640 × 128 × 96: 80 m around and 12 m deep, a 1.5× lake. Founding takes minutes.
